create_SamPredictor: create a SamPredictor instance initialized with a SAM model for mask prediction
set_image_SamPredictor: set an image on SamPredictor and compute its embedding for subsequent mask predictions
predict_SamPredictor: predict segmentation masks from point or box prompts using SamPredictor
get_image_embedding_SamPredictor: retrieve the image embedding tensor from SamPredictor after an image has been set
reset_image_SamPredictor: reset SamPredictor state to clear the currently set image and its embeddings
